get.description: Returns the group's active custom questions and the current user's diary entry (if any) for the specified date. The `date` parameter must be the caller's **local date** in `YYYY-MM-DD` format so that users in different timezones each see their own correct diary day.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The diary date in the user's local timezone (YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: Active group questions and the current user's diary entry (if any) for the given date.

400.description: date must be a valid ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

get.summary: Get diary context for a given date

get.description: Returns every group member paired with their diary entry (and answers) for the specified date. Members who have not written an entry for that date are included with `entry: null`. Requires group membership.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The diary date in the user's local timezone (YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: Group members' diary entries for the given date.

400.description: date must be a valid ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

get.summary: Get all group members' diary entries for a given date

post.description: Creates the caller's answer for a custom question on the given date. If the user has no diary entry for that date yet, one is created automatically.
